capabilities.title: Werewolf Solutions
capabilities.summary: Read the PSM business and validate its paid cloud billing and storage service through the Werewolf API.
capabilities.usage: Use Werewolf for authoritative PSM business and cloud-service readiness. Treat customer data and all money-moving operations as unavailable; this capability is read-only.

capabilities.title: Feedback Hub
capabilities.summary: Work with registered apps, feedback clusters, and roadmap items.
capabilities.usage: Use Feedback Hub to inspect and triage feedback. Never dismiss or promote feedback without the user's approval.

capabilities.title: Daedalus
capabilities.summary: Inspect and operate infrastructure through Daedalus's governed MCP tools.
capabilities.usage: Use Daedalus for infrastructure context and operations. Treat write actions as proposals unless the user explicitly approves them.

capabilities.title: Control Room specification
capabilities.summary: Pinned architecture, interfaces, schemas, decisions, requirements, and roadmap for Control Room.
capabilities.usage: Consult the attached Control Room specification when designing integrations, event envelopes, approvals, or execution flows. It is reference material; do not assume an unimplemented design is already running.
